copyright: Case (shell, front frame, side key, power slide), face (glass, display, keyboard, trackball) and materials: Kleidos, built from no vendor file (_shared/tdeck_plus_case.py, from this repository's drawings and measurements). Printed legends (the keys', the glass's and the keyboard plate's, and the back's T-DECK names, the outline round the large one, the mascot and the LILYGO wordmark): from Kleidos's own front and back drawings, glyphs outlined from Inter 4.1, © 2016 The Inter Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
notes: No vendor file: the case is shapes of this spec, written by _shared/tdeck_plus_case.py from front.svg's outline, glass and plate, measurements.json and the places this repository records for the openings, with what those leave open measured on LILYGO's published product pictures (the script's docstring lists each figure). The build frame: +Y towards the top (the screen's end), +Z out of the screen, +X towards the power slide; the case's left edge at x = 0, its bottom at y = 0 and the front frame's top at z = 0. The back's four prints (back.svg, back_tdeck_plus.py) lie on the back's flat face at z -19.0.

source.license_note: Built from no vendor file: every part is a shape of this spec, from this repository's own drawings and measurements.

materials.name: relief
materials.note: The back's relief lines, as dark as the PINMAP back picture shows them against the case (white-balanced the same way).

materials.name: brass
materials.note: The nut's brass, sampled on LILYGO's PINMAP back picture (218, 186, 141) and white-balanced in linear light the way the back's ink is onto the case's #525357.

meshes.name: case_shell
meshes.note: Written by _shared/tdeck_plus_case.py: the walls from the back's edge to the front frame, cut where the openings are, the back's slope and its flat face (z -19.0, which the back prints on), the nut's boss and the back's relief lines.

meshes.name: case_relief
meshes.note: Written by _shared/tdeck_plus_case.py: the back's relief lines, which the picture shows dark, 0.2 mm proud of the flat face: the top frame's lower edge, the badge's pocket and five rings, the two lines from its foot to the sides, and the groove round the nut's boss, one step out.

meshes.name: case_frame
meshes.note: Written by _shared/tdeck_plus_case.py: the front frame round the face, its top chamfered, its opening the glass's and the plate's outlines 0.4 mm in, and its two side rails.

meshes.name: key_left
meshes.note: The left face's key, 6.4 x 3.8 mm, as proud as the rails.

meshes.name: key_right
meshes.note: The power slide's knob in its slot, 0.45 mm proud.

meshes.name: case_marks
meshes.note: Written by _shared/tdeck_plus_case.py: what shows dark on the case, each one position step out of the face under it: the openings' floors, the bottom holes, the screw holes, the nut's ring and the lobe's hole, the knock-outs' rings and slots.

meshes.name: nut_insert
meshes.note: The brass 1/4-inch nut in its boss, one position step out of the boss.

meshes.name: grove_socket
meshes.note: The Grove connector seen through the left opening: its white housing standing on the opening's floor.

meshes.name: face
meshes.note: The black glass over the screen half (front.svg's glass, y 2.15..62.15), its edge inside the rim wall: the rim's opening there is x 3.04..70.22 with R10 top corners.

meshes.name: lcd
meshes.note: The panel's viewing area (front.svg's window), around the active area.

meshes.name: screen
meshes.note: One quantization step above the LCD's top, which rounds to -0.25 + 0.010: a depth test needs that step between them.

meshes.name: top_slot
meshes.note: The slot above the screen, of undocumented purpose (measurements.json): LILYGO labels nothing there, and the speaker sounds through the lower edge.

meshes.name: top_slot_dark
meshes.note: The slot's dark middle, from the slot's top (z -0.24 once quantized) to one position step over it: the two share no plane.

meshes.name: glass_legends
meshes.note: What front.svg prints on the black glass above the screen (its lilygo-glass group): the LILYGO wordmark, 0.03 mm over the glass's face (z -0.25), three position steps, as glossy as the glass it shows through.

meshes.name: keyboard_plate
meshes.note: The keyboard half's dark plate. Its outline (a rect and rounded rects fitted to the STEP) lies inside the rim wall at z -2.0..-1.6, so the rim's own inner edge is the edge one sees.

meshes.name: plate_edge
meshes.note: front.svg's silver plate edge beside the band and the keys (its straight run).

meshes.name: band
meshes.note: The dark band that holds the trackball (front.svg, y 62.15..73.75).

meshes.name: key_window
meshes.note: The light plate behind the keys (front.svg's window path).

meshes.name: keys
meshes.note: Each cap stands on its rim (key_rims, z -1.55..-1.30), from the rim's top up: no face of a cap lies on a face of the rim, whose outline holds the cap's whole, so a depth test never has to choose between the two.

meshes.name: key_legends
meshes.note: What front.svg prints on the 35 caps (its key groups), as geometry (legend_mesh.py): each key's letter or icon and its second legend, in the one ink the board prints them in, 0.03 mm over the caps' tops (z -0.15), three position steps. Every legend lies on its own cap, so a reader that presses a key moves that cap's legends with it.

meshes.name: plate_legends
meshes.note: What front.svg prints on the keyboard plate (its band-print and bottom-print groups), but for the discs of the two round marks: the traces and chevrons either side of the trackball, the rings of the two round marks beside the bottom row, and under the keys the LILYGO wordmark with its traces, rings and arrowheads. One plane, 0.03 mm over the band's face (z -1.55), three position steps, and 0.08 mm over the plate's (z -1.60).

meshes.name: plate_mark_legends
meshes.note: The solid part of the two round marks beside the bottom row (front.svg's round-marks group, on its plane plate-marks): a 2 mm disc split by a dark bar, each inside its ring. The discs are printed in the ink of the plate's hairline traces, and a mesh is one ink of one plane: on a plane of their own their mesh's stroke_mm is the discs' and not the traces', so a reader that leaves out the prints too thin to draw at its scale keeps the marks after the traces are gone. At the height of the rest of the plate's print (plate_legends), 0.08 mm over the plate's face (z -1.60), which they lie on with nothing between; no other print of the plate comes within 0.08 mm of them across. The marks are the drawing's own circles: no solid of this spec draws them.

meshes.name: trackball_ring
meshes.note: front.svg's trackball, stacked discs from the outside in: bezel r 5.15, metal ring r 4.75, dark gap r 3.45, white collar r 3.2, then the ball (equator r 2.48). Each disc starts where the one under it ends (the bezel on the band's face at -1.55, the metal ring on the bezel's at -1.45, the gap on the metal's at -0.95, the collar on the gap's at -0.94), so no two of them, nor the band, share a plane.

meshes.name: trackball
meshes.note: The ball as the spherical cap front.svg's dome implies: 2.48 mm in radius at the collar (z -0.88) and its top at z -0.06, so a sphere of radius (a^2 + h^2) / 2h with a = 2.48 and h = 0.82, cut at the collar.

meshes.name: usb_c_shell
meshes.note: The USB-C receptacle in the bottom end (the STEP's opening: x 32.49..41.73, z -10.7..-6.7).

meshes.name: frame_legends
meshes.note: What back.svg prints in the raised top frame of the back (its tdeck-frame group, plane frame): the large T-DECK, tone on tone, 0.03 mm out of the shell's flat back face (z -19.0), three position steps.

meshes.name: frame_line_legends
meshes.note: What back.svg prints round the large T-DECK (its tdeck-frame-line group, plane frame-line): the thin outline that follows the top frame, a 0.3 mm stroke in the same ink on the same flat face (z -19.0); a plane of its own, so the name keeps its own thinness.

meshes.name: badge_legends
meshes.note: What back.svg prints on the trapezoid's inner panel (its tdeck-badge group, plane badge): the LILYGO mascot over the panel's hole and the small T-DECK under it, on the same face and at the same height as the frame's name; a plane of their own, since their strokes are a third as wide.

meshes.name: base_legends
meshes.note: What back.svg prints on the flat band at the bottom end of the back (its lilygo-base group, plane base): the LILYGO wordmark and its registered sign, at the same height, short of the slope that rounds the end (the face is flat at z -19.0 to y 105.2 under the word).
